Origin and meaning

Sawyer comes from English and means “woodcutter”.

About the name Sawyer

An English surname for a woodcutter, and the hero of Mark Twain's Tom Sawyer.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Sawyer carries the meaning “woodcutter” and looks striking in brush strokes.
